claims.text: PATCH /api/settings with only some top-level sections (e.g. meta) updates those values and leaves all other sections (e.g. smtp) unchanged.
A partial update inside a section (e.g. only smtp.host or only meta.appName) changes just those keys and keeps the section's other previously saved keys.
An invalid settings update is rejected with a 400 validation error and none of the submitted values are persisted.
Secret settings such as the SMTP password are not exposed in settings responses after merging updates.
